messages:
maya: Heads-up — we're getting a reproducible allgather hang in us-central after yesterday's infra patch (driver 535.86 + nccl 2.15.1). Multi-GPU inference jobs (A100 pools) show 99p latency spikes and a few jobs stuck in ALLGATHER.
sam: Thanks — any logs? how widespread?
maya: Canary pool hit first (us-central-1g), then bucketed into a handful of production batches. Rough logs from a stuck job: 
```
[2026-03-17T21:10:45Z] NCCL WARN Socket : 104 Peer reset
[2026-03-17T21:10:45Z] NCCL INFO AllGather timeout on rank 3
[2026-03-17T21:10:46Z] kernel: nv_peer_kernel: WARNING: peer access failure for device 2
[2026-03-17T21:10:46Z] inference-runtime: KV cache stall on step 102
```
jordan: infra-bot shows the 21:05 UTC rollout applied driver 535.86 to us-central-1g. Can we correlate to the rollout window?
infra-bot: rollout: driver-535.86 applied to pool us-central-1g at 2026-03-17T21:05:12Z (canary -> partial).
li: Quick hypothesis — p2p/NVLINK handshakes failing after driver bump, causing socket fallback and then timeouts on collective ops. Mixed-firmware nodes show higher rate.
sam: Can we toggle P2P off for the affected nodes as a quick mitigation? Which env var?
jordan: We can set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 on the runtime for the pool and force the fallback to sockets; it may increase CPU/network cost but should avoid nvlink handshake issues. Worth trying on a small canary.
maya: Spun a canary with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 and pinned to driver 535.86 + nccl 2.15.1 — preliminary: reduced hang counts but 99p latency still elevated ~1.4s (vs 3s).
li: Another option: rollback driver -> 535.54 + nccl 2.14.3 on a canary and compare. Need signoff if we do mass rollback.
sam: Let's run two canaries in parallel: one with P2P disabled on current build, one rolled back to old driver+nccl. Capture perf and kernel logs for 30m. I'll own the rollback path if infra agrees.
jordan: Also add collectors: enable nettrace + nv_peer debug on canaries (low sample rate) and route traces to S3 for easy diff.
maya: Thanks — I'll queue both canaries now and tag ops. If rollback looks clearly better we should pause the remaining rollout. @ops @oncall please standby. :eyes:
infra-bot: alert: us-central inference latency anomaly detected (metric: allgather_time_p99) — spike at 21:08 UTC — auto-snooze disabled.
li: FYI: cost impact note — disabling P2P increases inter-node network egress and CPU usage; rough estimate +12% token cost for affected pools. Call out to finance if we scale it wide.
sam: Acknowledged. We'll keep it canary-first. Report back in 30.
maya: Adding a short runbook in the thread: 1) start canary A (P2P off), 2) start canary B (rollback), 3) collect traces/logs, 4) decide rollback vs config change, 5) pause rollout if either reduces hangs by >90%.
jordan: Good. Posting links to canary dashboards and log buckets in a followup message when ready.
